# Become a Podio Partner

Grow your business. Transform your customers. Help businesses modernize the way they work with the world's most flexible work management platform.

![](https://podio.com/images/default-source/products/podio/partners-banner.jpg?sfvrsn=4a97271f_1)

## Why Partner with Podio?

Today's businesses don't want another rigid application. They want solutions built specifically around how they operate. Podio gives partners the flexibility to create solutions for virtually any industry—without forcing customers to change their processes. By joining Podio’s Partner Program, you are joining a technology and consulting community with over 15 years of experience on the platform.

#### Sell AI-powered Transformation

Help customers automate workflows, connect business systems, and leverage AI across their operations.

#### Grow Recurring Revenue

Generate ongoing income through implementation services, custom development, automation, training, support, and managed services.

#### Differentiate Your Business

Deliver highly customized business solutions that competitors can't replicate with off-the-shelf software.

#### Join a Global Ecosystem

Collaborate with Podio experts, technology partners, and solution providers serving customers around the world.

## Choose Your Partnership

### Solution Partner

#### Perfect for

- Business consultants
- Digital transformation firms
- Systems integrators
- Implementation specialists

#### What you'll do

- Sell Podio
- Implement customer solutions
- Build workflows
- Deliver onboarding
- Provide ongoing support

### Technology Partner

#### Perfect for

- SaaS vendors
- AI companies
- ISVs
- Software developers

#### What you'll do

- Build integrations
- Build extensions
- Connect external platforms
- Create AI experiences
- Expand the Podio ecosystem

### Referral Partner

#### Perfect for

- Consultants
- Agencies
- Influencers
- Industry experts

#### What you'll do

Refer qualified opportunities to Podio and earn rewards without implementation responsibilities.

### Managed Services Partner

#### Perfect for

- MSPs
- Operations firms
- Outsourced business services

#### What you'll do

Operate Podio environments on behalf of customers while delivering ongoing optimization and support.

## Partner Benefits

### Strategic Partnership

- Quarterly webinar updates from Podio's leadership team
- Access to private Partner Community
- Annual Partner in-person meet ups
- Referral bonuses on net new customers and revenue share for existing customer expansion
- No earning caps

### Sales

- Online Deal Registration
- Up to 25% Referral incentives for life of customer and life of partner
- Joint sales opportunities
- Dedicated Partner Account Manager
- Sales enablement resources
- Dedicated Sales Account Manager

### Marketing

- Co-marketing campaigns
- Webinar opportunities
- Featured partner directory
- Social media promotion
- Customer success stories
- Marketplace exposure

### Technical

- NFR licenses
- Technical enablement
- API documentation
- Solution architecture guidance
- Early product previews
